GitLab Duo vs GitHub Copilot: a two week comparison
We ran both assistants on the same monorepo. Duo gave better review comments but setup was confusing, and support took a week to answer. Copilot was faster at completions but suggested deprecated APIs.
الدعم الفني بطيء لكن الميزات ممتازة والأسعار مرتفعة مقارنة بالمنافسين.
